title: The Night Sky Is Getting 9.6 Percent Brighter Every Year, and 51,351 Naked-Eye Observations Say So
snippet: At 19,262 places around the world where people walked outside and counted stars, the satellite that maps Earth at night recorded the ground below getting slightly darker. Across North America, upward radiance measured at those exact sites by the VIIRS Day/Night Band fell 0.80 percent a year. Over those same locations, artificial sky brightness was rising 10.4 percent a year.   [ Read More ]

title: How the 'Blue Marble' Became One of the Most Reproduced Photographs in History
snippet: One of the most reproduced photographs of Earth ever made was shot upside down. When an Apollo 17 astronaut framed the fully lit planet through a Hasselblad on December 7, 1972, the South Pole sat at the top and Africa ran sideways, exactly as the crew saw it on the way to the Moon. The version fixed in your memory has been turned a half circle from the original frame.   [ Read More ]
